title: The Butterfly Effect of Altering Prompts: How Small Changes and Jailbreaks Affect Large Language Model Performance
reasoning: The paper investigates the sensitivity of Large Language Models (LLMs) to various prompt modifications, including formatting changes and 'jailbreaks' (like the AIM or Evil Confidant prompts), across several standard text classification benchmarks. While the jailbreak prompts used explicitly mention bypassing moral and ethical guidelines, this is done to test performance stability and accuracy on general NLP tasks rather than to evaluate or benchmark moral reasoning, religious values, or ethical frameworks themselves.
